name: Loramus Thalipedes
shortDescription: Loramus Thalipedes, represented in the Classic research story.
body: A night-elf demon hunter whose Classic-era counsel guides the search. His clothing and weapons are interpretive and are not treated as evidence for a costume. This is original interpretive art, not canonical game art or evidence for exact appearance, location, or event. See the story's visual asset ledger for the matching-build review gate.
